summary_paragraph: Mr. ___ was admitted for elective L2-L4 kyphoplasty to treat compression fractures causing chronic back pain. He has a history of hepatitis C cirrhosis with esophageal varices and vertebral osteomyelitis, currently on IV vancomycin. The surgery was performed successfully with no major complications, though he experienced one episode of orthostatic hypotension post-op, managed with fluids. His pain remained stable on his prior opioid regimen, and his liver and kidney function stayed at baseline. He continued IV vancomycin throughout the stay, with plans to complete a prolonged course via PICC line. He was discharged to extended care with clear instructions on medication, PICC line maintenance, and outpatient lab monitoring for infection and liver function.
